products.name: Moisture Log Handoff
products.product: A focused water restoration moisture log handoff workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small water, fire, and property-restoration contractors
products.problem: Field readings, photos, equipment placement, affected materials, and daily decisions can remain on technician devices or in unstructured notes while office and next-shift staff need a defensible job history.
products.valueProposition: Turns water restoration moisture log handoff into a visible operating queue so every drying visit produces a time-stamped, location-specific record that supports the next field decision and controlled job documentation.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets water damage moisture log, restoration drying documentation, moisture mapping software, and restoration technician handoff searches.

products.name: Carrier Document Chaser

products.audience: small water, fire, and property-restoration contractors
products.problem: Adjuster requests, estimates, authorizations, photos, invoices, readings, and supplements are exchanged through long email threads without one list of what is owed and what was accepted.
products.valueProposition: Turns restoration insurance document tracking into a visible operating queue so every carrier document request has a defined artifact, owner, submitted version, acknowledgment, and resolved response.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets restoration insurance documentation, adjuster document tracker, restoration claim supplement, and carrier request workflow searches.
